name: Banshee

actions.name: Wail
actions.effect: All creatures within 9m must pass WILL save. On failure, they take full damage. Creatures that fail by 5 or more drop to 0 HP instead. Usable once per encounter.

actions.name: Corrupting Touch
actions.effect: Melee magical attack. The target's maximum HP is reduced by the damage dealt until they finish a long rest.

actions.name: Horrifying Visage
actions.effect: All creatures within 18m that can see the Banshee must pass WILL save or be frightened for 1 minute. Frightened creatures are paralyzed while they can see the Banshee.

reactions.name: Incorporeal Passage
reactions.effect: When hit by a physical attack, the Banshee shifts partially out of phase, reducing physical damage taken by half.

reactions.name: Mournful Cry
reactions.effect: When an ally within 9m is reduced to 0 HP, the Banshee lets out a cry. All enemies within 9m take 2d8 psychic damage.

traits.name: Incorporeal
traits.desc: Can move through creatures and objects as difficult terrain. Takes 2d8 force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Detect Life
traits.desc: Can sense all living creatures within 1.5km, knowing their exact location.

traits.name: Undying Grief
traits.desc: When the Banshee is reduced to 0 HP, it reforms after 24 hours unless its remains are blessed with radiant magic or its unfinished business is resolved.

lore: Banshees are the tormented spirits of elven women who were cursed in life by their own vanity or cruelty. Their wail is a harbinger of death, echoing across the night as a warning that none who hear it will soon forget. They haunt the ruins of places that held meaning in their mortal lives.
